title: Loved it until it logged me out
body: I really enjoyed this app. I felt I had things all organised within the app and it made sense. I went to log my water intake today, and the app was logged out and now has wiped all my hard work. Is there a way to get this back? I could cry! It really was helping!

title: Regret buying it
body:
It provides routines but minimal ability to customise them. 
Morning routine- get dressed but no shower
Cannot see a bedtime routine at all.
author: reets67

title: Frickin annoying
body: I don’t mind the concept and I know it’s necessary in my life, but does it have to literally push 20 notifications to my Apple Watch all at once while I’m at work every single day? It just makes me want to tear my watch off and throw it across the room.
author: Quantumarq

title: Absolute waste of time
body:
Everything is behind a paywall, and there’s no free trial or way to access the features of this app without paying. Genuinely ridiculous and if I had’ve known I wouldn’t have spent so much time putting my details in. Not that I care too much about having my details but I wouldn’t have gone through all of that had I known.
Guys please don’t waste your time, it’s just a predatory app that wants money.
author: whiskeyCat208

title: Disappointed
body: I was enjoying this app until I woke this morning and all my set up tasks were wiped
